image_description: A close-up macro shot of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a green leaf. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly brown with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) ringed in black and cream. The body is slender, hairy, and brown. One antenna is clearly visible with a clubbed tip. The background consists of blurred green foliage.
